description: Format raw changelog bullets into the project's release-note line format.

evals.name: Mixed types grouped in documented order
evals.prompt:
Format these release notes:
- feature: add dark mode toggle (#101)
- bug: fix crash on empty note (#102)
- docs: update install guide (#103)
- refactor: split parser module (#104)
- feature: export notes as PDF (#105)
- bug: stop duplicate saves (#106)
evals.expected_output: Six lines in the form '- [TYPE] Summary (#id)', grouped FEAT, FIX, DOCS, CHORE, with input order kept inside each group: #101, #105, #102, #106, #103, #104. The refactor bullet maps to CHORE.

evals.name: Bullet without issue number gets (#none)
evals.prompt:
Format these release notes:
- bug: handle null note title
- feature: add tag filter (#210)
evals.expected_output: Two lines: '- [FEAT] Add tag filter (#210)' first, then '- [FIX] Handle null note title (#none)'. The bullet with no issue number ends in (#none).
